initialExploration.finalChange: Move normalized children into JSON objects/arrays instead of serializing them again

limitations: Small non-quiescent microprofile; short timings and whole-test-process RSS are not service or consumer memory measurements
Test inputs and 500-iteration body unchanged across measured binaries; ordinary regression and a scoped Clippy annotation were added afterwards without changing encoder logic
Initial grouped repetitions retained; additional interleaved before/after and after/before pairs reduce, but do not eliminate, warmup/order effects
No timing assertion or threshold weakening in CI; semantic regressions and exact output identity gate the optimization
